skill.name: prescriptive-actions
skill.description: Provides recommended approaches, prioritized next steps, alternatives, tradeoffs, risks, and immediate actions for goal-oriented decisions.
skill.summary: Gives concise prescriptive guidance for choosing a practical next direction.
skill.author: BellaBe

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns in the single prompt-only skill file. Manual semantic review found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, executable code, network use, filesystem access, environment access, or command execution.

content.value_statement: Choosing the next move can be difficult when goals, risks, and tradeoffs compete. This skill turns an open question into a clear recommendation, useful alternatives, and immediate actions.
actual_capabilities: Restates the user goal in one concise sentence.
Recommends one primary approach with high-level steps.
Compares meaningful alternatives and when to use them.
Names tradeoffs across cost, speed, risk, and complexity.
Lists key risks that may affect the chosen direction.
Suggests immediate starting actions without creating a full checklist.
limitations: Does not create roadmaps or timelines.
Does not produce detailed runbooks or checklists.
Does not define success criteria or test plans.
Does not provide full risk mitigation plans unless requested.

use_cases.title: Choose a Product Direction
use_cases.description: Compare feature options and receive a recommended path with tradeoffs and first actions.

use_cases.title: Resolve Technical Direction
use_cases.description: Decide between implementation approaches while balancing complexity, delivery speed, and operational risk.

use_cases.title: Improve an Operational Process
use_cases.description: Diagnose a blocked workflow and get a practical direction before building a detailed plan.

prompt_templates.title: Recommend a Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: I need to decide what to do next about [goal or problem]. Recommend the best approach, alternatives, tradeoffs, risks, and immediate actions.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Options
prompt_templates.prompt: I am choosing between [option A] and [option B] for [goal]. Recommend one path and explain tradeoffs, risks, and first actions.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose and Prescribe
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with a messy situation
prompt_templates.prompt: Here is the situation: [context]. Diagnose the likely issue, recommend a direction, list alternatives, and identify immediate next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Executive Decision Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for concise leadership guidance
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare prescriptive guidance for [decision]. Include the goal, recommended approach, alternatives, tradeoffs, key risks, and immediate actions.

output_examples.input: What should we do to reduce onboarding delays for new customers?
output: Goal: Reduce the time and friction required for new customers to become active.
Recommended approach: Focus first on the highest-friction handoff and remove avoidable manual steps.
Alternatives: Add more support coverage, or simplify the onboarding scope for the first week.
Tradeoffs: Automation saves time but may need setup effort. More support is faster but increases cost.
Key risks: Solving the wrong handoff, adding process overhead, or missing customer-specific blockers.
Immediate next actions: Review recent onboarding cases, identify the slowest step, and choose one change to test.

output_examples.input: Should our engineering team centralize documentation or let each team manage its own docs?
output: Goal: Improve documentation quality without slowing team delivery.
Recommended approach: Use a shared standard with team-owned content and central governance.
Alternatives: Fully centralize ownership, or keep documentation fully distributed.
Tradeoffs: Central governance improves consistency but adds review work. Team ownership keeps context close.
Key risks: Outdated content, unclear ownership, and review bottlenecks.
Immediate next actions: Define required sections, assign owners, and review one high-value area first.

best_practices: Provide the goal, context, constraints, and known options.
Ask for tradeoffs when cost, speed, risk, or complexity matters.
Use the output to choose direction before requesting a detailed plan.
anti_patterns: Do not use it when you need a detailed timeline.
Do not use it as a substitute for legal, medical, or financial advice.
Do not ask for exhaustive procedures when a runbook skill is more suitable.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps turn open-ended decision questions into recommended approaches, alternatives, tradeoffs, risks, and immediate actions.

faq.question: Does it create full project plans?
faq.answer: No. It gives directional guidance and first actions, not a roadmap, timeline, or detailed task plan.

faq.question: Can it compare multiple options?
faq.answer: Yes. It can compare meaningful alternatives and explain when each option is appropriate.

faq.question: Is it useful for technical decisions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can recommend a technical direction when you provide context, constraints, and available options.

faq.question: How much context should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the goal, current problem, constraints, urgency, available resources, and any options already under consideration.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
